items.lede: Newly unsealed court filings show Microsoft privately called OpenAI's data practices "theft" while both companies scraped paywalled Times content, built datasets from it, and warned internally it would gut publishers.
items.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping ‘the largest theft of labor in human history,’ new unredacted filings reveal

items.lede: Recently unsealed court documents in the New York Times' case against OpenAI and Microsoft are pretty damning. items.title: OpenAI and Microsoft knew they were starting a ‘doom loop’ for the web
